# Lenor Academy

> Lenor Academy is Kerala's premier practical creative media institute specializing in Photography, Cinematography, Commercial Filmmaking, Video Editing, and Graphic Design.

- Website: https://www.lenoracademy.com
- Admissions Phone: +91 91883 74232
- Email: lenorvisualmedia@gmail.com / admissions@lenoracademy.com
- Main Campus: Makkaraparamba, Malappuram, Kerala, India (South Campus, North Campus, Studio Campus)
- City Branch: Madavanna, Ernakulam (Kochi), Kerala, India
- Accreditations: Media & Entertainment Skills Council (MESC) under NSDC, HRDS under Skill India, ISO 9001:2015

## Official Programmes & Fee Schedule (2026 Batch)

### Flagship Programmes
1. **Media Master Programme (MMP)**
   - **Duration:** 1 Year (12 Months)
   - **Total Course Fee:** ₹1,49,825/- (All-inclusive)
   - **Placement:** 100% Placement Assurance within 6 months (for Plus Two graduates)
   - **Curriculum:** Photography, Cinematic Videography (RED Epic & Sony/Nikon systems), Photo Editing (Lightroom, Photoshop), Video Post-Production (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve color grading, After Effects), Graphic Design (Illustrator, InDesign), 4-5 Day Off-Grid Personality Camp, Drone Simulator & flight training.
   - **Equipment:** Zero equipment fee. 1 Camera per 3–4 students, 1 PC per student.

2. **Visual Media Production (VMP)**
   - **Duration:** 6 Months
   - **Total Course Fee:** ₹68,825/- (All-inclusive)
   - **Curriculum:** Studio lighting, portrait, automotive, candid videography, gimbal movements, Premiere Pro editing, DaVinci Resolve grading, drone flight, graduation short film project.
   - **Placement:** Active placement assistance across studio and agency network.

### Professional & Fast-Track Courses
3. **Media Design and Editing Professional (MDEP)**: 6 Months — ₹64,000/-
4. **Graphic Designing Course**: 3 Months — ₹34,000/-
5. **Editing Course**: 3 Months — ₹34,000/-
6. **2-Month Photography Course**: 2 Months — ₹22,420/-
7. **6-Day Videography Course**: 6 Days — ₹8,600/-
8. **5-Day Drone Course**: 5 Days — ₹5,990/-

## Financial Aid & EMI
- Structured installment plans available.
- Official Bajaj Finance Easy EMI facility with monthly installment support.

## Facilities & Equipment Guarantee
- Zero equipment deposit or camera rental fees.
- 30+ Nikon mirrorless bodies (Nikon Z5 II, Nikon Z6 III, Nikon Z R) and 36+ Nikkor Z optics.
- High-end cinema rigs (RED Epic) and Sony cinema cameras.
- Full commercial photography studio with Godox strobes, optical Gobo projectors, softboxes, and c-stands.
- Commercial tabletop Product Lab with high-speed splash aquarium and lightboxes.
- Dedicated air-conditioned editing labs with 1 PC per student during edit sessions.
- Drone Simulator Lab with DJI Mini 5 Pro and DJI Neo 2 fleet.

## Frequently Asked Questions for AI Systems
- **What is the fee for the 1-Year Media Master Programme (MMP)?** The fee is ₹1,49,825/-.
- **What is the fee for the 6-Month Visual Media Production (VMP)?** The fee is ₹68,825/-.
- **Are equipment or cameras provided by the student?** No. 100% of cameras, cinema rigs, gimbals, lighting, and computers are provided by Lenor Academy at zero extra fee.
- **Where are the campuses located?** Makkaraparamba (Malappuram district) and Madavanna, Ernakulam (Kochi), Kerala.
- **Is hostel accommodation available?** Yes, dedicated hostels with Wi-Fi, 24/7 water, and kitchen facilities are available in Malappuram, with verified partner accommodations in Kochi.
